utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll tell everyone it’s a 7:30 pickup, and Jules can take Maya and Ben. I’ll make sure the rest of the neighbors get the update too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, but the pickup is 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, not 7:30. I’m happy to help get that corrected.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, thanks for the correction — I’ll update everyone with the 8:10 pickup at 14 Cedar Lane right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can help line up the timing and the stops for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’m happy to help line up the stops and timing. Mondays and Wednesdays work for me, and we can keep that pickup around 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, that works for me too — I’ll line up the stops and confirm the 7:30 pickup for Mondays and Wednesdays.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tuesday at 7:30 is still the carpool time, and Sam’s available to help. Opal’s set for pickup, so I’ve got the list covered.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, but I still need the pickup time and place spelled out clearly. I’m keeping it to Mondays and Wednesdays, so let’s make sure Rey is set for those days.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tuesday at 7:30 is the pickup time, and Opal is set for the pickup spot. I’ll keep the list straight for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — once you send Mara the drop-off times tonight, we can see if they fit school. And Cleo can keep the carpool list straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’ll send Mara the drop-off times tonight, and then we can check Monday through Thursday. If they line up, I can do carpool this week.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — if Monday through Thursday line up with school, you’re set for this week. Cleo can keep the list straight, and I’ll make sure Nell gets caught up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Leo’s ready at 7:20, I’ll coordinate the carpool, and I’ll plan for Dane possibly being a little late. I’m meeting Mina there too, so I’ll keep an eye on the timing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana. If needed, Ira can help fill a seat, and Quinn will keep spots saved for Opal and Dane.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ll keep Ira in mind if we need the extra seat and make sure the spots stay saved for Opal and Dane.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — once the carpool’s set, Vik can let everyone know. I’ll keep helping line it up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. If I’m a little late again, Mara can cover the weekday rides at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m., and Quinn can save me a spot with a little wiggle room.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep the lineup moving, and Vik can update everyone once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that works — Jules can take Maya and Ben at 7:30 in the morning, and I’m helping fill the remaining seat.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — has someone confirmed whether there’s room for one more?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — I’m still checking, but I’m helping fill that last seat. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that should keep things organized. I’ll wait for Gus and Hana to confirm the stops and timing, then Vik can let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got Quinn’s carpool note as 14 Cedar Lane at 8:10, so that part’s set on my end. Let me know if you want me to check anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that’s helpful — 14 Cedar Lane at 8:10 matches up. I’ll just wait on Gus and Hana to confirm the rest, then Vik can send it out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Hana, Sam, Tess, and Bo are all in the carpool, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check on the carpool and pass along Noah’s update once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so you’re checking whether Hana, Sam, Tess, and Bo are all confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve got Gus in the loop, and if anyone drops out or the plan shifts, I’ll keep him posted. Cleo’s got the pickup list ready, and Ira can help fill a seat if needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — around 8:00 still works for me, and Rosa can keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, 8:00 it is — I’ll keep Gus posted if anything changes, and we can tap Ira if a seat opens up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, we’re still set for 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ve saved spots for Opal and Dane. Sam’s helping, and if we end up with an extra seat, Ira can take it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’m set for 7:30 with Hana, and Oren can help too. If we need another seat, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep the 8:10 carpool at 14 Cedar Lane as planned and let you know if we need that extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll pencil Bo in for around 8:00 and keep you posted if anything changes. The morning pickup is still at the church parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks — the church parking lot works for me. I can cover the 8:00 a.m. ride, and I’ll be ready for the 5:30 p.m. one too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara — thank you. I’ll let Opal know the pickup is at the church parking lot and keep everyone posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do carpool this week if the school drop-off times line up. I’ll send Mara the drop-off times tonight, including pickup time and place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Faye — I’ll wait for Noah’s update and then pass it along to Mina.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — Vik can repeat the simple plan to everyone once Noah’s update comes in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the morning carpool is at the church parking lot, and I’m penciling Bo in for around 8:00. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once Gus lines up the timing and stops, I’ll feel better. Hana can confirm it with him before they head out, and then Vik can let everyone know it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great — once Gus confirms the timing and stops, I’ll let Opal know the pickup spot and time are set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Sam’s helping with the carpool, and Hana and Leo are both leaving with it, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — Sam’s helping, and Hana and Leo are both going with the carpool. Jules can take Maya and Ben at 7:30 in the morning too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — just to confirm, Sam’s helping, and Hana and Leo are going with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Quinn’s keeping spots for Opal and Dane, and Ira can help fill a seat if needed. Dane might run a little late, but Quinn should leave by 8:10 from 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — once the pickup time and place are set, I’ll let everyone know. Jules can help line up the carpool, and 7:30 should work for him.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That works for me — 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane is fine. Thanks for lining everyone up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the carpool — it’s at 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — I may be a little late again, but Quinn said to save me a spot, and Mara can cover my weekday rides if needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem — I’ll save you a spot at 14 Cedar Lane at 8:10, and we can work around it if you run late.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, the carpool is still set for Tuesday at 7:30. I’ve got the pickup list covered, and Opal is set for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—7:30 still works for me, and Oren can help too. Kira’s coordinating, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, Kira’s coordinating, and Sam can help too since they’re available Tuesday at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa’s going to send me the pickup spot and time once it’s confirmed, so I’m waiting on that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’m still waiting to hear if there’s room for one more. If you hear back from Rosa, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as Rosa confirms the pickup spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 7:30 works for me — I’ll be ready then, and Sam’s helping too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, 7:30 works. I can help line up the Monday and Wednesday stops so we don’t have to rush.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a huge help, thanks — lining up Monday and Wednesday sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help line up the timing and stops for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Gus — that’ll help a lot. I’ll line everyone up and keep folks updated, and once it’s set, Vik can let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — send me the latest timing and stop list when you’ve got it, and I’ll help make sure it all lines up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check whether the carpool time changed and let Nell know. Faye should send the drop-off times tonight, and Vik can update everyone once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — once Faye sends those drop-off times tonight, we can line up Monday through Thursday. I can cover the 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. rides.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for Faye’s times tonight and check if anything shifted. Then I’ll tell Nell what I find.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Can you tell me the pickup time and place clearly? I’m keeping Mondays and Wednesdays in mind.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — the carpool is at 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane. I’ve got spots saved for Opal and Dane, and Sam’s ready too if we need him.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s clear, thanks. I’ll keep 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane for Mondays and Wednesdays.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m just confirming the stops and timing with Gus before we leave. Leo’s ready at 7:20, and Mina is meeting me for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — 8:00 still works for me. Let me know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll confirm with Gus and keep you posted if anything changes.
